subject: general
question: Two successive discounts of 40% and 60% on a deal are equivalent to a single discount of:
solution:
Given:

The successive discounts are 40% and 60%.

Formula used:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 40%, Y = 60%

⇒ 40 + 60 - 2400/100

⇒ 100% - 24% = 76%

∴ The single equivalent discount is 76%.
